item.text:
Refactored the core algorithm in [RabinKarp.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/022_rabin_karp/RabinKarp.java) to be stateless and more reusable:

- `search` now accepts `CharSequence` instead of only `String`
- rolling-hash state is now plain local data instead of a mutable helper object
- returned match lists are now immutable via `List.copyOf(...)`
- empty-pattern and short-text handling are explicit helpers instead of inlined edge-case logic

I also expanded the self-checks in [RabinKarpTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/022_rabin_karp/RabinKarpTest.java) to cover `StringBuilder` input, and verified everything with:

- `javac RabinKarp.java RabinKarpDemo.java RabinKarpTest.java`
- `java RabinKarpTest`
- `java RabinKarpDemo`

If you want another pass, the next useful step would be turning this into a small packaged project layout with separate `src/main` and `src/test` structure.
